summary: Live Nation Entertainment filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting an amendment to Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary Michael G. Rowles' employment agreement, extending its term from December 31, 2027 to December 31, 2029. Effective January 1, 2028, Rowles becomes Senior Legal Advisor at a $500,000 base salary with no contractual bonus; severance is a lump sum through 2029 if terminated without cause or for good reason. The company separately announced hiring Da-Wai Hu as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary effective November 2, 2026. This is a planned, orderly leadership transition and executive compensation matter, not a special situation.
